import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    R = int(data[0])
    out = []
    for i in range(R):
        left = "".join(str(j) for j in range(i, -1, -1))
        right = "".join(str(j) for j in range(1, i + 1))
        out.append(left + right)
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

main()
